question: Which of the following oceans extends into the Mediterranean Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atlantic Ocean**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Atlantic Ocean** extends into the Mediterranean Sea.
 
• The Mediterranean Sea is connected to the Atlantic Ocean by the **Strait of Gibraltar**.
 
• This strait is a narrow passage that separates Europe (Spain) and Africa (Morocco).
 
• The Mediterranean Sea is almost completely enclosed by land, bordered by Europe to the north, Asia to the east, and Africa to the south.
 
• The exchange of water between the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea is crucial for the marine ecosystems of both bodies of water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Strait of Gibraltar** is approximately 13 kilometers (8.1 miles) wide at its narrowest point.
 
• The Mediterranean Sea has been a crucial route for trade and cultural exchange between different regions and civilizations throughout history.
 
• It is one of the world's busiest waterways, with significant maritime traffic for shipping and transportation.
 
• The Mediterranean region is known for its unique climate, characterized by hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters.
 
• Several important ancient civilizations, including the Egyptians, Phoenicians, Greeks, and Romans, flourished around the Mediterranean Sea.
